description.summary: With the grandest of flourishes, you can immediately end all 1st level or higher songs you are currently maintaining to a wider area while prolonging its effects.
description.value: With the grandest of flourishes, you can immediately end all 1st level or higher songs you are currently maintaining to a wider area while prolonging its effects. The range of all the songs that you have ended as part of Grand Finale are doubled, and their effects persist for a duration equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier without you having to maintain them. Song effects on creatures behave as if they are continually within the song’s range (ex: forcing a save on a creature for every round until they fail or the song duration ends).
